paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the Recall@50 and NDCG@50 metrics for two different methods, Ours and ReFICR, across a range of search depths. The x-axis represents the search depth, ranging from 1 to 5, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis, labeled “Recall@50@50” and “NDCG@50@50”, is linear and extends from approximately 0.15 to 0.60. The line indicated by the dark green color and solid marker shape represents Recall@50 (Ours), starting at approximately 0.33 at a search depth of 1 and rising to approximately 0.52 at a search depth of 5.  A dashed line, colored in green, represents Recall@50 (ReFICR), beginning at approximately 0.21 at a search depth of 1 and ascending to approximately 0.22 at a search depth of 5.  A blue line, styled with a dotted marker shape, displays NDCG@50 (Ours), starting at approximately 0.18 at a search depth of 1 and culminating at approximately 0.48 at a search depth of 5. Finally, a blue line, depicted with a dotted marker style, indicates NDCG@50 (ReFICR), beginning at approximately 0.16 at a search depth of 1 and reaching approximately 0.19 at a search depth of 5.
